entities.name: Thendar
entities.description: A Kav Pirate from the Sothera system in the Edge, a former imperial moxite miner with a grudge against the Kav Empire.

entities.name: Kav Empire
entities.description: The empire Thendar once worked for and now steals from.

entities.name: Kavaron That Is
entities.description: Where Thendar was deposited after being fired.

events.summary: Thendar skims ore as a miner, is fired and deposited back on Kavaron That Is.
events.quote: Swiftly fired from his position and deposited back on Kavaron That Is

events.summary: Thendar now steals from the empire.
events.quote: Thendar now steals from the empire

relations.quote: Thendar has a grudge against the Kav Empire .
